# Alcoa Aluminium Scaffolding

> ISO 9001:2015 aluminium scaffolding manufacturer, supplier and rental company based in Musaffah 37, Abu Dhabi, UAE. Legal name: ALCOA ALUMINIUM SCAFFOLDING - L.L.C - S.P.C. Serves Abu Dhabi, Musaffah, Dubai and UAE projects with aluminium towers, cuplock, ladders, erection and inspection.

- Address: Ar Rahmah 4 St., Musaffah 37, Al Mantaqah As Sinai'yah 1 Street - Office number 11, 1st Floor, Abu Dhabi, UAE
- Hours: Mon–Sat 8am–6pm
- Website: https://alcoascaffolding.com
